title: Supreme Court Collegium Recommends Judges for High Court Chief Justices
summary: The Supreme Court Collegium has recommended judges for appointment as Chief Justices of different High Courts.

title: Supreme Court Stays High Court Proceedings Challenging Sahyog Portal
summary: The Supreme Court has stayed proceedings pending before High Courts concerning challenges to the Centre's Sahyog portal.

title: Supreme Court Addresses Representation of Women in Bar Bodies
summary: The Supreme Court has issued directions concerning representation of women in Bar bodies.
